description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_SafeIframe' which implements security checks for safe iframe URLs, including configuration setup and filtering logic.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_SafeIframe
classes.description: A filter class to ensure that iframes are loaded from safe sources, configurable via regex and whitelist of hosts.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the regex pattern from configuration for later matching.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Determines whether a given URI should be allowed based on iframe safety rules and configured whitelists.
